name: PostgreSQL MCP Server
description: Enables AI agents to query, explore, and analyze PostgreSQL databases through the Model Context Protocol. It provides robust security features including read-only mode, schema restrictions, and query timeouts for safe data interaction.

rawRecord.description: Enables AI agents to query, explore, and analyze PostgreSQL databases through the Model Context Protocol. It provides robust security features including read-only mode, schema restrictions, and query timeouts for safe data interaction.

sslMode.description: SSL connection mode. Options: disable (no SSL), prefer (use SSL if available), require (force SSL).

timeout.description: Query timeout in seconds. Queries exceeding this duration are automatically terminated. Range: 1-300.

readOnly.description: When enabled, only SELECT and EXPLAIN queries are permitted. Prevents all data modifications.

allowedSchemas.description: List of database schemas AI agents can access. Queries are restricted to these schemas only.

maxQueryResults.description: Maximum number of rows returned by a single query. Range: 1-10,000.

connectionString.description: PostgreSQL connection URL in the format postgresql://username:password@host:port/database
